brief: Can a retry after a timeout book one invoice twice? Use fresh read-only workers for the review.

assign-timeout.body: Trace the timeout path in invoice_export/client.py. Can a retry submit twice?

assign-fixtures.body: Find a fixture in tests/ that makes the first API call time out.

fixtures-finding.body: SlowOnceApi in tests/test_client.py:6 times out once and records every request_id.

timeout-finding.body: Confirmed with SlowOnceApi: client.py:15 makes a new request_id on each attempt.
